title: Countdown Timer
description: A customizable local countdown timer with Web Audio alarm notifications when complete.

faq.q: How does the countdown alarm work?
faq.a: When the timer hits zero, CoolTools uses the browser's Web Audio API to synthesize a pleasant electronic alarm chime. No remote audio assets are loaded.

faq.q: Will the timer work if I switch tabs?
faq.a: Yes. The timer updates by computing timestamps relative to system performance time, ensuring precision even when the tab is backgrounded.
